incident-bot: PAGER: Increased 5xx rate (user requests) in hosted-us-west1 — current 5xx=11.8% over 5m, latency spike. Paging primary oncall Sasha L. @Sasha L
Sasha L: I'm on a train, ETA ~45m. can someone cover primary for the next hour? :wave:
Liam K: I can take primary for the next 2 hours. putting myself as primary in the rota. @Sasha L are you handing off any active runbook steps? :thumbsup:
Sasha L: thanks Liam. no runbook started, just initial paging. customers affected: a subset of hosted customers behind model-route v3. note: recent canary pushed last night.
Maya G: linking runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/latency-5xx — start with quick rollback to model v2 fallback if traffic aligns, otherwise scale dedicated pool. :eyes:
David R: looking at metrics — error traces show runtime OOMs on worker-g2 instances and a spike in queue length. probably KV cache thrash after canary. can we route traffic to region fallback eu-west while we stabilize?
Liam K: I can open a bridge but want to avoid cross-region for low-latency customers. plan: 1) set canary weight 0 -> rollback, 2) scale dedicated worker pool by +2 gpus, 3) enable prefix caching sticky for known long prompts. doing step 1 now.
deploy-bot: deploy rollback request received: rollback model-route v3 -> v2, initiated by Liam K (id: dpl-17485-1)
Liam K: rollback applied, waiting for propagation (30s). monitoring.
Priya S: I'll shadow and monitor customer-facing alerts and update CS if needed. I'll also run the smoke test for top-10 customers.
incident-bot: Metric update: 5xx dropped from 11.8% -> 4.3% in 60s post-rollback. Latency 95p also improving.
Maya G: good signal. recommend still scaling until we confirm OOM root cause. David, can you attach the worker logs to the ticket? put key stack traces in the incident ticket.
David R: grabbing logs, noticing repeated allocation failures in quantized kernel path. filing a follow-up with eng-runtime (ticket #ENG-7182) and adding trace snippets.
Liam K: scaled dedicated pool +2 GPUs (action: autoscale override). also toggled conservative batching for the impacted queue.
Sasha L: thanks all — I’m stepping away. Liam, you’re primary now. if anything escalates, ping me with @Sasha L urgent and call bridge.
Liam K: noted. I'll run through checklist: runbook step 2 (scale) done, step 3 (cache) in progress. Priya, any customer replies yet?
Priya S: CS posted a proactive note to affected customers: "We're investigating elevated errors, mitigation in progress; we'll update in 30m." no immediate escalations.
incident-bot: Update: 5xx now 1.1% over 5m. Deploy rollback stable. Recommend keeping oncall coverage until next handover. :white_check_mark:
Liam K: keeping shadow for 1.5h. Maya/David — please follow up with a post-incident action item: validate quant kernel fallback and add canary health gating.
Maya G: will add a runbook improvement PR and schedule a small test to reproduce OOM path. thanks for the quick handoff everyone. :raised_hands:
Sasha L: appreciate the coverage. logging this thread into the incident ticket and marking my handoff as complete. safe travels. :train:
Liam K: acknowledged. leaving a short note for the next rotation about the canary and quant kernels. closing bridge in 20m if stable. :lock:
deploy-bot: Bridge closed by Liam K (dpl-17485-1).
